about: Pinned ReXGlue SDK binaries (our own data, no game content). tools\build.ps1 refuses to build/stage when a rex*.dll it would stage, or one already staged next to the exe, is not listed here (name + sha256). Add entries with: pwsh -File tools\build_sdk.ps1 -Run NAME -Pin "note". rexglue.exe (codegen) is listed for traceability; build.ps1 only reports it. Newest entry last.

pins.built: rexgpu-xenos.dll 2026-10-09 01:03:26 (logs/sdk_build_s7c_b.log, 13 s after the d251216 merge commit); rexruntime.dll and rexglue.exe 2026-10-08 21:25 (sdk_build_s7b_b), reported Up-to-date by the s7c_b install, i.e. unchanged by the later commits
pins.verified: staged copies in out/build/win-amd64-release equal thirdparty/rexglue-sdk-vulkan/bin (REXSDK) and thirdparty/rexglue-sdk-src/out/win-amd64/Release byte for byte (sha256); no SDK source file newer than the staged rexgpu-xenos.dll; SDK tree clean apart from the libmspack submodule (symlinks checked out as plain files on 2026-10-07, not used by these changes)
pins.note: Session 7c build (4K60 entrances; vulkan_texture_load_direct etc.), staged since 2026-10-09 01:03 and seeded as the first pin in Session 8. rexglue --version reports g285328a: the version string is baked in at CMake configure time, so it does not identify the SDK commit; these hashes do.
